### Load libraries

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(signal)
```

### Load data

```{r}

FaceLogRaw <- read_csv("treasure_hunters_2026-01-14.csv", 
                       col_types = cols(.default = col_guess())
)


# FaceLogRaw is your tibble with columns:
# session_code, participant_id, round_number, id_in_group, face_log (character JSON)

# 1) Parse each JSON cell -> tibble (cols = channels; rows = frames within chunk)
parse_face <- function(s) as_tibble(fromJSON(s, simplifyVector = TRUE))

FaceLog <- FaceLogRaw %>%
  mutate(data = map(facelog, parse_face)) %>%
  select(-facelog) %>%
  unnest(data) %>%
  group_by(session_code, participant_id, round_number) %>%
  arrange(session_code, participant_id, round_number, timestamp) %>%
  mutate(timestamp=timestamp - min(timestamp)) %>%
  ungroup

```

#### Take summary

```{r}

FaceLogSummary <- FaceLog %>%
  group_by(session_code, participant_id, round_number) %>%
  summarize(
    end = which.max(timestamp),
    frames = n(),
    seconds = max(timestamp, na.rm=TRUE),
#    mean = mean(eyeBlinkLeft + eyeBlinkRight, na.rm=TRUE)/2
  ) %>%
  ungroup %>%
  mutate(
    fps = frames/seconds,
    end = cumsum(end),
    start = end - frames + 1 
  )
  
```

### Blink Schedule

```{r}

threshold <- 0.35

leftBlinkIndices <- which(FaceLog$eyeBlinkLeft >= threshold)

rightBlinkIndices <- which(FaceLog$eyeBlinkRight >= threshold)

# split into consecutive streaks
left <- cumsum(c(1, diff(leftBlinkIndices) != 1))

right <- cumsum(c(1, diff(rightBlinkIndices) != 1))

leftSplit <- split(leftBlinkIndices, left)

rightSplit <- split(rightBlinkIndices, right)

leftPeaks <- c()

rightPeaks <- c()

for (i in leftSplit) {
  
  peakIndex <- which.max(FaceLog$eyeBlinkRight[i])
  
  leftPeaks <- c(leftPeaks, i[peakIndex])
  
}

for (i in rightSplit) {
  
  peakIndex <- which.max(FaceLog$eyeBlinkRight[i])

  rightPeaks <- c(rightPeaks, i[peakIndex])
  
}

blinkMatches <- leftPeaks[leftPeaks %in% rightPeaks]

for (i in 1:nrow(FaceLogSummary)) {
  
  start <- as.numeric(FaceLogSummary[i, "start"])
  end <- as.numeric(FaceLogSummary[i, "end"])
  
  blinkSubset <- blinkMatches[blinkMatches >= start & blinkMatches <= end]
  
  blinkSchedule <- as.vector(FaceLog[["timestamp"]][blinkSubset])
  
  BlinkConnection <- file(paste0(i, ".BlinkData.bin"), "wb")
  
  writeBin(blinkSchedule, BlinkConnection, size=4, endian="little")
  
  close(BlinkConnection)

}
```

### Smoothing filter

#### Define Savitzky-Golay function

```{r}

# Circular function so the buffer can wrap around the end

sg_circ <- function(x, p = 3, n = 21, m = 0, ts = 1) {
  N <- length(x)
  y <- sgolayfilt(rep(x, 3), p = p, n = n, m = m, ts = ts)
  y[(N + 1):(2 * N)]
}

smooth_sg <- function(df, group, time, p = 3, n = 21, m = 0, ts = 1) {
  exclude   <- c(group, time)
  num_cols  <- names(df)[vapply(df, is.numeric, logical(1))]
  targets   <- setdiff(num_cols, exclude)   # numeric cols except group/time

  df %>%
    arrange(across(all_of(c(group, time)))) %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group))) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(targets),
                  ~ sg_circ(.x, p = p, n = n, m = m, ts = ts))) %>%
    ungroup()
}
```

#### Execute

```{r}

window <- 21

polynomial <- 3

FaceLogSmooth <- smooth_sg(
  FaceLog,
  group = c("session_code", "participant_id", "round_number"),
  time  = "timestamp",
  n = window, p = polynomial
)
```

#### Blink Smoothing (Not used)

```{r}

FaceLog$eyeBlinkLeft[leftPeaks] <- 1
FaceLog$eyeBlinkRight[rightPeaks] <- 1

blinks <- FaceLog %>%
  select(session_code, participant_id, round_number, timestamp,  eyeBlinkLeft, eyeBlinkRight) %>%
  mutate(
    eyeBlinkLeft = ifelse(eyeBlinkLeft >= 0.15, eyeBlinkLeft, 0),
    eyeBlinkRight = ifelse(eyeBlinkRight >= 0.15, eyeBlinkRight, 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(session_code, participant_id, round_number, timestamp) %>%
  group_by(session_code, participant_id, round_number) %>%
  mutate(
    eyeBlinkLeft = sg_circ(eyeBlinkLeft, p=2, n = 3),
    eyeBlinkRight = sg_circ(eyeBlinkRight, p=2, n = 3)
  )
  
blinks$eyeBlinkLeft[leftPeaks] <- 1
blinks$eyeBlinkRight[rightPeaks] <- 1

```

#### Test

```{r}

start <- as.numeric(FaceLogSummary[1, "start"])
end <- as.numeric(FaceLogSummary[1, "end"])

FaceLogCirc <- FaceLog[start:end,] %>%
  mutate(timestamp=timestamp + max(timestamp, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  rbind(FaceLog[start:end,])

FaceSmoothCirc <- FaceLogSmooth[start:end,] %>%
  mutate(timestamp=timestamp + max(timestamp, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  rbind(FaceLogSmooth[start:end,])

ggplot(FaceLog[start:end,], aes(x=timestamp, y=eyeBlinkLeft))+
  geom_point(color="lightcoral")+
  geom_point(data=blinks[start:end,], color="steelblue")+
#  facet_wrap(~ session_code + participant_id + round_number)+
  theme_minimal()
```

#### Write

```{r}

HeadList <- list()

HeadLog <- as.matrix(FaceLogSmooth[,Quaternion])

EyeLog <- as.matrix(FaceLogSmooth[,TargetBlendshapes])

EyeList <- list()

TimeLog <- as.vector(FaceLogSmooth[["timestamp"]])

TimeList <- list()

for (i in 1:nrow(FaceLogSummary)) {
  
  EyeConnection <- file(paste0(i, ".EyeData.bin"), "wb")
  
  HeadConnection <- file(paste0(i, ".HeadData.bin"), "wb")
  
  TimeConnection <- file(paste0(i, ".TimeData.bin"), "wb")

  start <- as.numeric(FaceLogSummary[i, "start"])
  
  end <- as.numeric(FaceLogSummary[i, "end"])
  
  HeadList[[i]] <- as.vector(t(
    HeadLog[start:end,]
  ))
  
  writeBin(as.vector(HeadList[[i]]), HeadConnection, size=4, endian="little")
  
  close(HeadConnection)
  
  EyeList[[i]] <- as.vector(t(
    EyeLog[start:end,]
  ))
  
  writeBin(as.vector(EyeList[[i]]), EyeConnection, size=4, endian="little")
  
  close(EyeConnection)
  
  TimeList[[i]] <- TimeLog[start:end]
  
  writeBin(as.vector(TimeList[[i]]), TimeConnection, size=4, endian="little")
  
  close(TimeConnection)
  
}

# ---- 1) EyeHeader.json (names only) ----
writeLines(
  toJSON(list(order = TargetBlendshapes), auto_unbox = TRUE),
  "EyeHeader.json"
)
```
